topics.title: TV Evangelist and Toast Observations
topics.summary: The broadcast centers on a conversation between hosts discussing televangelists, particularly producer Fred de Cardova’s unsettling timing and behavior during Jack Benny's death. The discussion shifts to absurdities like French toast consumption and personal anxieties, with recurring references to the New York Post.

topics.title: French Toast Ritual
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts repeatedly discuss and demonstrate eating French toast with syrup – involving opening tins, dumping butter and syrup onto it, poking holes in lids, and consuming fallen pieces. They question Fred’s methods while dismissing concerns about hygiene or weight, creating an unusual focus on the process of consumption.

topics.title: Phone Call and Phony Tape Recall
topics.summary: During a studio discussion, hosts address an unusual phone call from a woman detailing personal needs while simultaneously referencing previously recorded phony calls featuring guests like Joan Rivers. The conversation includes recalling past bits involving Tourette's syndrome and negotiating old comedy segments, highlighting the use of fabricated scenarios for entertainment.

topics.title: Caller Confusion and Dial-a-Mattress
topics.summary: Multiple callers discuss their experiences with Dial-a-Mattress, including Fred’s recent purchase of a king-size bed delivered within two hours. They debate mattress types and share anecdotes about meeting new people through the service, highlighting a shift in Fred's lifestyle while discussing various beverage brands.

topics.title: NBC Staff Discussions and Screenwriting Plans
topics.summary: During a studio conversation, NBC staff members discuss recent personnel issues involving an employee’s termination after being denied access to buildings, speculating about potential misconduct related to relationships like that of former employee Brenda. Simultaneously, they debate the details of Howard Stern's screenplay – centered on French toast and courtroom drama – while discussing its development.

topics.title: Bridge Jumpers, Letterman & Bob Boatman's Death
topics.summary: Two Rhode Island tile setters attempted to gain attention for David Letterman by jumping off the George Washington Bridge. Simultaneously, director Bob Boatman died in a shooting accident at his home while opening a drawer, and reporters filmed the stunt for local news broadcasts.
